scope: Local Windows test-infrastructure remediation only; not a Rambler service or engine qualification

mechanism.new_object_policy: Explicit protected owner/current-user, SYSTEM and administrators DACL; existing parent ACLs unchanged
mechanism.pins: Owned top-down directory handles, FILE_TRAVERSE requested, no FILE_SHARE_DELETE, handle-based security and identity checks
mechanism.runtime_pin_check: DELETE-access handle request failed with sharing violation while pinned and succeeded after release; no rename, deletion or preexisting-object mutation

review_and_correction_history: Attributes-only directory handles did not enforce sharing; reviewed correction requests traversal access and adds regression assertions
Identity record uses a file-specific descriptor without directory inheritance flags
The drive-root-only TrustedInstaller owner literal was corrected after local OS name lookup and independent deterministic public service-SID derivation agreed; a synthetic regression test was added
remaining_gates: Verified-source/protected-binary launcher integration and fresh review
Source and input provenance, safe offline generator and sentinel validation
Credential admission before the irreversible single-opportunity reservation
limits: No protection against hostile same-user or administrator processes
Directory pins do not prevent file-content writes; verified source and protected binary handling remain required
Creation and subsequent handle admission are not one atomic operation
No general confidentiality, live access, Android parity, performance or ASR claim
